## ChitChain Pull Request

### Summary
Provide a brief summary of the changes introduced in this PR.

### Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that causes existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Smart Contract update
- [ ] AI Agent / CrewAI adjustment
- [ ] Documentation / Configuration

### Verification & Testing
- [ ] Contract unit tests pass (`npm test`)
- [ ] Backend builds without errors (`npm run build` in `/backend`)
- [ ] Frontend builds cleanly (`npm run build` in `/frontend`)
- [ ] Verified on local Hardhat node or Sepolia testnet

### Security Checklist
- [ ] No private keys or environment secrets committed
- [ ] Reentrancy and access controls reviewed
- [ ] Input sanitization applied
